title: アカデミックライティング(再履修クラス)
subtitle: Academic Writing
keywords: Method to Make Out Reports 2.Method to Reference Literature 3.Method to Gather Information
educationalGoal: During the process of problem-finding and -solving, it is necessary to acquire the ability to summarize your own ideas or opinions and offer them as information. Therefore, students will:(1) cultivate the skills to make out reports in their own specialized field, (2)learn the preparation procedures for reports on topics based on their own specialty, and (3) learn the fundamentals of writing academic papers.
advice: This is a basic writing skills course. We will cover the following topics: 1. Problem-finding 2. Gathering, analysis, and organizing of information 3. Problem-solving 4. Report preparation 5. Distinguishing between plagiarism and referencing Students are required to understand technological trends in mechanical engineering fields. Students are required to find problems in mechanical engineering fields. Students are required to gather, analyze, and organize information related to discovered problems. Students are required to acquire proper methods of expression in reports on mechanical engineering fields.
books: Textbooks: Basics of Writing Technical Sentences: What Is Written Language?, Agne Shofu Sha, in Japanese Reference books: None Reserved books: None

 CLIP学習プロセスについて
 一般に、授業あるいは課外での学習では:「知識などを取り込む」→「知識などをいろいろな角度から、場合によってはチーム活動として、考え、推論し、創造する」→「修得した内容を表現、発表、伝達する」→「総合的に評価を受ける、GoodWork!」:のようなプロセス(一部あるいは全体)を繰り返し行いながら、応用力のある知識やスキルを身につけていくことが重要です。このような学習プロセスを大事に行動してください。
